description: Sign a structured record of one governed step and add it to the Fabric Verify log: a tool call, its result, an approval, a delegation, a policy decision, a halt, and so on (format augmentev/fabric-agent-event/v1). Spends $0.005 of prepaid credit. The event stays on this machine with its salt. Action details stay private: the public log holds only a salted fingerprint of the payload, the action kind and time, and coded identifiers that only the user, or an auditor they give an audit pack to, can link to this agent. Returns `record`: later events link to it (a tool call's approval_record, a tool result's request_record, parent_record). For a tool call, give `body.tool` and `body.arguments` (hashed for you), or `action`; an approval of that call gives the same `action`, so both name the same action. When the account's policy requires approval for tool calls, set body.approval_record and it is presented to the log. Bundle a run with export_events for an offline check. The check shows each event was logged unchanged and every link points to an earlier event of the right type. It does not show that a described tool result is true.

action.description: For tool_call, approval and policy_decision: the tool, server and arguments the action is about. Fills action_sha256 by the published recipe, so a call and its approval match.

body.description: The event's fields. tool_call: tool, arguments (or arguments_sha256), optional server, call_id, approval_record. tool_result: request_record, is_error, result (or result_sha256), optional call_id. approval: approver_id, decision (approve/deny), action_sha256 or `action`. delegation: to_agent_id, task_sha256. Others: see the format.

delegation_record.description: The delegation record that handed this agent its task.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Retry with the same value and the same event to resend the same signed record; charged at most once.

kind.description: Only when the event allows several kinds (delegation: message_sent or decision; third_party_access: data_read, data_write or credential_use).

parent_record.description: An earlier record this one follows from.

run_id.description: Your run identifier; export_events bundles a run by it.

name: record_event
title: Record an agent event (costs $0.005)
